title: Explicit affine-space tower and its composite adjunction
statement: Let S be a scheme and A a commutative coefficient ring. Set X_d=AffineSpace (ULift (Fin d)) S. Split the last coordinate by the polynomial-coordinate isomorphism X_(d+1) ≅ A1_(X_d), and let j_d:X_(d+1)→P1_(X_d) be its standard open chart. Define L_0 as exact etale sum extension along X_0→S and R_0 as exact inverse image. Recursively define L_(d+1)=Dj_d! followed by Rq_d* followed by L_d, and R_(d+1)=R_d followed by the projective-line right functor followed by j_d*. For N positive, finite A killed by N, Noetherian S and N a unit on S, L_d is left adjoint to R_d for every d. The functors are explicit composites, with no choice of data from existence.

source.place: Proof of cor-amb-affine-space-adjunction: successive affine-line projections and addition of twists

proof.text: Use the last-coordinate equivalence, affine-space reindexing and the sum isomorphism. The resulting open chart composed with both projections is the affine-space projection. Finite type and quasi-compactness over S make every X_d Noetherian.
At zero use the exact derived etale sum-extension/inverse-image adjunction along the isomorphism X_0→S.

Induct on d. Pull the unit N along X_d→S. Compose the projective-line adjunction with the induction adjunction, then the open-immersion adjunction. The reversed composite is exactly the recursively defined R_(d+1).

theorem nonempty_ambientTowerAdjunction (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))) (d : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (ambientTowerLeft A S d ⊣ ambientTowerRight A N hA S d)
